symbols.name: logical bit volume
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in a padded transform box, counting every entry at its record width.
symbols.quote: The logical bit volume $\Upsilon$ counts the bits of the [padded transform box](padded-transform-box.md), with every entry at its record width.
